spec.concept: Brand card asking who reviews smart contract code before it ships, anchored by the firm's audit focus
spec.scene: Deep navy background with a minimal amber grove-of-trees motif made of simple geometric lines, a thin amber rule beneath a large centered white headline, calm and precise engineering feel, no characters or extra text
spec.alt_text: Navy brand card with a minimal amber grove motif and the words smart contract audit firm in white

spec.concept: Reentrancy: state updated after an external call lets a callback repeat execution
spec.scene: Technical card on a deep navy background. A simple flow diagram shows a withdraw function sending Ether to a recipient contract, with an amber arrow looping back into the function before the balance box is cleared. A white label marks the unchanged balance. A small badge in the corner reads high severity.
spec.overlay_text: clear the stored balance before calling the recipient
spec.alt_text: Diagram of a withdraw function sending Ether to a contract whose callback loops back into the function while the balance is still unchanged, with the text: clear the stored balance before calling the recipient.

spec.concept: Credibility through completed audit work, presented as a calm, precise brand card for a smart contract audit firm.
spec.scene: Minimal brand card on a deep navy background with a thin amber accent line beneath a large white headline. A simple abstract grove of vertical lines suggests sentinel trees alongside a small shield outline made of clean geometric strokes. No people, no code snippets, no badges.
spec.alt_text: Brand card with navy background and amber accent line reading 'completed 12 audits', with abstract grove lines and a shield outline.

spec.concept: Business logic flaw: code runs correctly but the rules it encodes permit exploitable outcomes
spec.scene: Technical diagram on a deep navy background: a lending contract flow where a borrow request is checked against the requested amount instead of collateral balance, with the mismatched invariant check highlighted in amber and a broken link between collateral and borrow capacity
spec.overlay_text: the code does what it says, but what it says permits exploitable outcomes
spec.alt_text: Diagram of a lending contract where the borrow check uses the requested amount rather than collateral balance, with the missing invariant highlighted in amber on a navy background.

spec.concept: Education card on reentrancy: state must be updated before external calls to prevent callback-driven repeat withdrawals.
spec.scene: Minimal dark navy background with a simple diagram of two boxes labeled contract and callback connected by a looping amber arrow, with a clean white headline area and generous spacing in the brand style.
spec.overlay_text: Update state first, then call out.
spec.alt_text: Brand card with a navy background and an amber looping arrow between two boxes, illustrating a callback re-entering a contract, with the text: Update state first, then call out.

spec.concept: Technical card on ERC-4626 vault inflation attack: a donation to the vault skews the share price so a depositor's shares round down to zero.
spec.scene: Dark navy background with a simple diagram of a vault box. A small token labeled 1 share sits inside, a large arrow labeled donation points into the vault, and a victim deposit arrow leads out to a zero. Amber accent lines highlight the rounding step, with clean white monospace text and ample spacing.
spec.alt_text: Diagram of an ERC-4626 vault where a direct token donation inflates the share price, so a victim's deposit is rounded down to zero shares.
